correctness.rationale: The established Mellin diagonalization makes the sharp sector norm equal to sup_ξ F_lambda(ξ). Differentiation gives F′=2(B−A)/Z² where A and B are positive cross-integrals and their pairwise-sum supports are strictly separated by a+b; hence d/dξ log(A/B)>0. Endpoint domination gives exactly one crossing, and strict crossing yields negative second derivative and nonattainment on L² frequencies. With τ=2ξ/λ, strict concavity of h_τ=log sinθ−τθ identifies a unique saddle. Uniform Laplace saddle and Watson endpoint estimates for two excluded tails give τ* as equal-endpoint exponent slope, order-one d* shift, and exact K/√λ leading loss coefficient. Symmetric sector τ*=d*=0 check produces sqrt(6/(πλ))(√3/2)^λ.
